rules.invariant: Agent commands are created only by createAgentCommand; only a command authorizes a turn.
rules.fix: Call createAgentCommand(db, {...}) from apps/server/src/agent-command.ts instead of inserting the row; it owns depth, dedupe and wake routing.

rules.invariant: Corner state (corner_facts) is written only by the corner module.
rules.fix: Change corner state through the corner module: advanceCorner/lockCornerLifecycle in apps/server/src/corner-lifecycle.ts, or closeCornerState in apps/server/src/corner-close.ts. If the module lacks the write you need, add a named function there and call it.

rules.invariant: A corner is archived only by closeCornerState or the merge path, so its run, wakes and state end with it.
rules.fix: Close the corner with closeCornerState(db, cornerId) from apps/server/src/corner-close.ts. It archives the room, cancels commands, abandons the workflow run, deletes wake sources and advances the corner to closed.

rules.invariant: A pull request is merged only through GitHubOperations.landCorner.
rules.fix: Merge through GitHubOperations.landCorner, the only merge path (AGENTS.md merge authority); it checks the exact-head yes, green checks and holds.

rules.invariant: Live notifications are published only by postgres-live.ts, so its decoder sees every event.
rules.fix: Publish through a named notifier in apps/server/src/postgres-live.ts (add one beside notifyConnectorAssignment) and call it, so LiveNotification and its decoder cover the event.

rules.invariant: Server background work runs on the leader's work queue, not on free-running intervals.
rules.fix: Use one of three shapes: a global job via the leader's work.add in apps/server/src/background.ts; a timeout chain owned by one connection and cleared in its close handler; or a due-time wake (agent_schedules/work_schedules). Do not add a setInterval.

rules.invariant: Memberships are written only by the membership module.
rules.fix: Change membership through a named helper in apps/server/src/membership-join.ts (add one there if needed) and call it.

rules.invariant: The server and shared contract never branch on a harness name; harness behaviour lives in the helper's AgentKind tables.

rules.invariant: Helper behaviour per harness is read from AgentKind tables, not from scattered harness-name comparisons.
